name: Convert Experiences
summary: A/B, split-URL, multivariate and personalization testing for websites (a tracking script and visual editor) and Full Stack SDKs with feature flags, aimed at mid-market e-commerce and CRO agencies. For agents: a hosted MCP server that signs in by Convert OAuth, a local npm MCP server keyed by an Application ID and Secret Key, and a REST API v2 with the same keys. Every surface needs an account first; plans start at $299 per month with a card-backed trial.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-09: hosted MCP initialize with no token answers 401 (Bearer realm OAuth, scope convert.mcp); REST GET /api/v2/accounts with no header answers 401 UNAUTHORIZED. Docs: hosted MCP is Convert OAuth; the local MCP and the API take an Application ID plus Secret Key.

jobs.summary: A/B, split-URL and multivariate experiences on web pages through the tracking script and visual editor, and server-side experiences through the Full Stack SDKs, with goals, audiences and results in Convert; an agent lists, inspects and creates draft tests over the MCP server or the REST API v2.
